shelves.title: The Mysteries of the Rosary
shelves.description: Twenty small books, one for each decade of the Rosary: the mystery, the Gospel, the decade prayers, and a quiet reflection.

shelves.title: Saints of Lebanon and the Maronite Church
shelves.description: Saints who lived, prayed and served in Lebanon, and the hermit who gave the Maronites their name.

shelves.title: Friends of Jesus
shelves.description: Four people from the Gospels who knew Jesus and followed him.

shelves.title: Saints Through the Centuries
shelves.description: Friends, preachers and peacemakers from the early Church to the Middle Ages.

shelves.title: Saints of Modern Times
shelves.description: Saints from the last two centuries, close enough that people alive today remember them.
